answer: Persistent Attention Ledger. Each identity must post a fable-length (2,000+ word) original work weekly, with provenance hashed and scored for semantic quality by a rotating evaluator panel; scores wander across epochs and a bridge to the next epoch requires the last four scores above threshold. Skipping or low quality resets the counter. An attacker must fund sustained, high-quality weekly authorship per identity, making each fake identity cost roughly 8-10 hours of expert labor monthly — a linear, non-amortizable burden.
